title: gentianella pseudolycopodium
intro: Gentianella pseudolycopodium, commonly known as the alpine gentian, is a species of flowering plant in the gentian family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to stimulate digestion, improve appetite, and alleviate symptoms of indigestion and stomach upset. The therapeutic actions of gentianella pseudolycopodium include its bitter and carminative properties, which help to stimulate digestive enzymes and relieve flatulence. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, such as gentiopicroside and loganic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
